source_doc.title: Lumentum Q2 FY2026 Earnings Call — ELS/CPO/UHP Laser Segment——coverage-gap edges addendum wave 2（自主研究迴圈第 6 輪）
source_doc.permission_basis: The source is a Motley Fool earnings transcript. Motley Fool's terms permit one intact personal, non-commercial copy but prohibit other storing, posting, and abstracts without prior written permission; source-derived raw and extraction artifacts therefore stay out of Git.

sources.quote: Three previously identified growth catalysts were reiterated: cloud transceivers, optical circuit switches (OCS), and co-packaged optics (CPO)... A fourth driver was newly introduced: optical scale-up.

sources.locator: Passage 7 — Components breadth: CW lasers, scale-across, pump lasers
sources.quote: pump lasers hit a record with revenue up over 90% YoY, supporting long-haul, subsea, and new scale-across architectures.
